comment: Official Her Interactive game patches. Source of truth for both setup-game-patches.sh (download + bundle) and GamePatchCatalog.swift (apply). Scraped from https://www.herinteractive.com/support/game-patches/ — see docs/game-patches.md.

patches.title: Flower puzzle in Aunt Eloise's safe
patches.fixes: Corrects the flower puzzle in Aunt Eloise's safe.

patches.title: Mattie's cabinet
patches.fixes: Clicking Mattie's cabinet wrongly sends the player to Dwayne's office.

patches.title: Senior Detective puzzle timer
patches.fixes: Grants more time for puzzles on the Senior Detective difficulty. A difficulty preference rather than a bug fix, so it is not applied automatically.

patches.title: Freezes and CSound errors
patches.fixes: Resolves multiple freezes and assorted CSound errors.

patches.title: Bird inlay puzzle solver
patches.fixes: Marks the bird inlay puzzle as already solved. Her Interactive says not to install it unless you cannot solve the puzzle yourself, so it is never applied automatically.

patches.title: Simone's purse, projector room, and installer
patches.fixes: Closing Simone's purse with closed captioning off, a Modify/Repair/Remove prompt when Treasure in the Royal Tower is already installed, and being confined to the projector room on day 3.

patches.title: Phone call and monolith freezes
patches.fixes: Freezes while on the phone or at the monolith.

patches.title: Navigation, photos, journal, and bucket fixes
patches.fixes: Dead navigation arrows, exits while photographing birds, being unable to leave the journal, repeated bird-photo requests, and the bucket not leaving inventory.

patches.title: Cola puzzle solver
patches.fixes: Marks the cola puzzle as already solved. Her Interactive says not to install it unless you cannot solve the puzzle yourself, so it is never applied automatically.

patches.title: CSound crash in the wood-sample conversation
patches.fixes: Crash with a CSound/DirectSound error when talking to Casey about the wood samples.

patches.title: Clamming activity
patches.fixes: Lets the clam bucket be handed in when not all clams can be found. Her Interactive frames this as a last resort after re-checking both clam locations, so it is not applied automatically.

patches.title: Zrender error, fifth key, and scene error
patches.fixes: Zrender error during the campfire scene, a scene-stack error at the painting, and the fifth key vanishing before it reaches inventory.

patches.title: Cricket ball and column key
patches.fixes: The cricket ball never being added to inventory, and the column key vanishing before it reaches inventory.

patches.title: Taffy sort puzzle
patches.fixes: Cursor freeze during the taffy sort puzzle.

patches.title: ICE Updater 1.1.2 (CD)
patches.fixes: Ned phone freeze, Guadalupe availability, S3/VIA Unichrome picture-in-picture, and slow end-game chase performance. The site lists this same file again on its S3/VIA Unichrome page.

patches.title: ICE Updater 1.1 (digital download)
patches.fixes: The digital-download build of the same four fixes as ICE Updater 1.1.2.

patches.title: Isis command box (ICE Updater 1.0.1)
patches.fixes: The Isis command menu staying on screen after saving with it open. This is an older updater than 1.1.2 and applying it afterwards would roll the game back, so it is not applied automatically.

patches.title: Missing fifth mushroom
patches.fixes: Inventory showing only four mushrooms after five have been collected. Her Interactive states this updater covers both the CD and digital-download editions.

patches.title: Walk-in-place and Kyler freeze (CD)
patches.fixes: Nancy walking in place on the map early on, and the conversation with Kyler freezing later.

patches.title: Walk-in-place and Kyler freeze (digital download)
patches.fixes: The digital-download build of the same two fixes as HAU 1.1.

patches.title: Doppler radar screen
patches.fixes: Flickering or black screen on the Doppler cable puzzle with GeForce 2/4 MX cards.

patches.title: Recorder channels and tea ceremony labels
patches.fixes: Being unable to delete recorder channels when all are full, and missing item labels during the tea ceremony. Her Interactive labels this PC-only because the Mac build self-updates; a wrapp runs the Windows build, so the PC patch is the right one.

patches.title: Locked letters in the decode puzzle
patches.fixes: Letters A, F and N locked in the wrong position or duplicated in the Amateur Sleuth decode puzzle. This patch is a data file copied into the game's Ciftree folder, not an installer.
